items.text: 4 world markets made big moves over the past week, led by Gold, which fell 8.9%.
The NIFTY 500 rose 0.8% on 20 Nov. Diversified was the strongest sector (−0.0%) and Forest Materials the weakest (−1.2%).

FIIs bought a net ₹10,308 Cr and DIIs sold a net ₹4,860 Cr of Indian shares on 20 Nov. Foreign investors are quietly accumulating in 65 niches; Pipes & Tubes, Gas Transmission & LNG and US Generics joined today. Heavy delivery buying this week in Large PSU Banks, Luggage & Bags and Small PSU Banks.
